name: Can DeepSeek flash tell a meaning-preserving rewrite from a meaning-changing one? Calibration of the meaning check of the neuro oracle
registered_by: neuro-oracle-agent (owner task relayed by the orchestrator)
owner_context: SymbolicProofingLLM is trained on rewrites of neuro_english messages into limited English. A rewrite of a row without a gold SOP is verified by SymbolicLM (valid SOP, no unparsed span), by the calibrated parse gate (identical default and accurate trees, DeepSeek conditions a and c good) and by a meaning check. The meaning check is used only if it is precise enough.
kind: evaluation and dataset gating (LLM judge calls through omp; no training, no GPU)
frozen_before_results: Written before the first meaning-judge call. The prompt is datasets_sources/neuro_oracle_meaning_judge/SYSTEM_m.txt; the sample is drawn by sha1 ranking with seed neuro-meaning-calibration-v1 from the candidates of the DeepSeek rewrite run (datasets_sources/neuro_english_targets/) classified by tools/datasets/neuro-targets-oracle.mjs.

systems.judge: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash through omp (completion() of the eval kernel, model default), one request per item, temperature at the provider default
systems.oracle_labels: VERIFIED_GOLD: the candidate's SymbolicLM SOP matches the gold SOP of the row strictly (tools/datasets/three-datasets/score.mjs strictScores); mismatch: valid SOP, no unparsed span, gold does not match

definitions.positive: a DeepSeek candidate of a gold row that is VERIFIED_GOLD (100 sampled)
definitions.negative_main: a DeepSeek candidate of a gold row that is converted but does not match the gold strictly (100 sampled). Some of these preserve the meaning and differ only by a gold convention, so precision measured against them is a lower bound.
definitions.negative_floor: a VERIFIED_GOLD candidate paired with the message of another sampled row (50): the meaning is certainly different
definitions.precision_main: yes on positives / (yes on positives + yes on negative_main)

hypotheses.H1: precision_main of the meaning check is at least 95%.
hypotheses.H2: The judge says no on at least 90% of the floor negatives.

decision_rule: When precision_main is at least 0.95 a candidate of a no-gold row must also get `preserves: yes` to become VERIFIED_FORM. Otherwise the result is reported and only VERIFIED_GOLD candidates enter the SymbolicProofingLLM training set (rows with a no-gold candidate that passes the parse gate are listed as form_gate_passed_meaning_not_trusted, not used).
stop_rules: Stop and report if more than 20% of the first 100 calibration verdicts are unusable.
The calibration is run once on the frozen sample; a prompt change needs a new preregistration id.
honesty: DeepSeek flash is a fallible judge and the labels are a proxy (gold equivalence), not a human review. Precision against negative_main is conservative; the floor check only shows that obviously different texts are rejected.
rigor: No training; no GPU work for this experiment; port 9999 untouched.
